_comment: Rename this file to prefill.json and drop it in app/ before packaging to pre-seed a personal build. Applied once per install. Leave it out (or leave it named .example.json) for a generic build. An entry with registKeyB64 + rpKeyB64 becomes a ready-to-stream console; an entry with only host/accountId/ps5 shows as unpaired so you just enter the 8-digit link code once.
